notes: Investigated celloworld.com thoroughly for any genuine seasonal/holiday PLP category, with particular attention to Diwali given the Indian houseware market context. Site is a custom headless Next.js storefront (not standard Shopify JSON endpoints exposed) on a Shopify-style /collections/<handle> URL scheme. Method: (1) robots.txt checked -- 'Allow: /' for User-Agent *, no Claude-specific disallow, so proceeded via Tier 1/2. (2) Tier 1 HTTP: fetched sitemap.xml (486 URLs total, 11 top-level nav collections + ~92 sub-collections) and grepped all URLs for diwali/christmas/holi/rakhi/raksha/navratri/new-year/valentine/halloween/easter/thanksgiving/festive/festival/mother's day/father's day/eid/pongal/onam/ganesh/puja/diya/thali/pooja/rangoli/toran/seasonal -- zero matches except a generic '/collections/festive' URL and generic gifting collections (tea-set-gifting, storage-set-gifting, snack-set-gifting, bowl-set-gifting, opalware-gift-sets, glass-gift-sets, personalized-gifts, gifts-for-kids, gifts-under-499/999/1000-1499/500-999) which are occasion-agnostic gift-bundle/price-tier collections, not holiday-specific PLPs. (3) Because the site is JS-hydrated (Next.js app router; SSR HTML omits product grids), switched to Tier 2 Playwright (installed local chromium via npx playwright install) to render pages and hover-expand the full desktop mega-menu across all 11 top-level nav buttons (Hydration, Personalize, Tableware, Kitchen, Tiffin Boxes, Cookware, Appliances, Cleaning Essential, Kidzbee, Porcelain, Glassware), collecting 92 unique submenu links -- none seasonal/holiday-named; all are product-type or price-tier collections ('Under ₹999/1999/2999/5999'). (4) Directly visited /collections/festive rendered -- shows 'No Products Found' (empty/dead collection, confirming it is not a live seasonal PLP). (5) Visited /pages/gifts -- renders as a generic 'Top Gifts' page (occasion-agnostic bestseller gift picks), not tied to any specific holiday, so excluded per the genuine-holiday-association rule. (6) Tested internal site search for 'diwali' via /search?q=diwali (rendered with Playwright) -- returned only generic/unrelated bestseller products (same items shown site-wide), i.e., a zero-result search falling back to generic recommendations, not a diwali-specific result set. Per rules this alone is not proof of absence, so it was only used as corroboration after the full nav/sitemap sweep already found nothing. (7) Checked mobile hamburger menu (rendered at 390px viewport) for any additional promotional/seasonal banners not present in desktop mega-menu -- only found 'Shop gifts by price' (Under ₹999/1999/2999/5999) and category shortcuts (Hydration, Lunch Boxes, Dinner Set, Bathroom Set), no holiday content. (8) Checked for a Hindi-language nav/site variant -- none found (no language switcher, no /hi/ path, English-only site). No genuine Diwali, Holi, Raksha Bandhan/Rakhi, Navratri, Christmas, New Year, Valentine's Day, Halloween, Easter, Thanksgiving, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Eid, or any other festival/seasonal category exists anywhere in the site's taxonomy, nav, sitemap, or search. Cello World's catalog (steel/plastic/glass houseware, hydration, cookware, kidzbee kids range) is organized purely by product type and price tier, with no seasonal/festival merchandising taxonomy at all. Concluding status: no_seasonal with rows: [].
